title: Mindfulness and wellbeing with horses near Bath
description: Quiet connection, mindful grooming, observation, grounding, mindful walks and creative reflection with the ponies at Creative Rein, near Bath.

sections.heading: Mindfulness & Wellbeing
sections.lede: Creative Rein's entire culture is based around connection, communication, transparency and collaboration.

image.alt: A black pony lying down in the paddock, with Bathford and the valley behind

sections.heading: We include the ponies
sections.body: We can only bring all of these together by working together. We ask the ponies if they are OK, we observe their behaviour, read their movements and communicate accordingly. We include them, involve them and connect.

image.alt: A girl leaning in to greet a black pony in the yard

sections.heading: Let him into your heart
sections.body:
All of our horses love humans, even those that have been badly treated.

Our poor ex-racer was forced to race as a one-year-old. When he didn't perform as expected, he was left, moved on and pushed through auctions, as many horses of that age are in the world of racing. I rescued him only three months ago. He had scars, he was neglected and thin, with a sparse coat.

Yet now his scars are healing, he follows us around like a dog and likes to be involved in everything. He trusts us and we trust him.

Because of his experience, he holds a deeper connection with humans. Let him into your heart and he'll let you into his.

items.title: Quiet Connection
items.text: Spending time beside our unique ponies and horses, noticing their breathing, movement and quiet resting habits.

image.alt: Two horses eating hay side by side

items.title: Mindful Grooming
items.text: Slow, gentle movements. Feel the undulations, the textures, sounds and sensations, but importantly, notice how the horse reacts, softens, enjoys, relaxes and embraces your touch.

items.title: Observation
items.text: Observation is magical when discovering horses. They communicate angrily, softly, happily or with confusion in a matter of seconds, depending on you, another horse, danger or change. They communicate subtly through their ears, their eyes, posture and movement. Watch them.

image.alt: Poppet looking over her stable door

items.title: Breathing & Grounding
items.text: Grounding yourself is paramount. Touching the warmth of a horse, feeling the muscle, closing your eyes and smelling their skin evokes an immense sense of peace.

image.alt: A brown and white pony looking out of its stable

items.title: Mindful Walks
items.text: Wonderful mindful walks in beautiful countryside: gentle rolling hills and woodland paths with a myriad of birds, animals and wild flowers.

items.title: Creative Reflection
items.text: Part of our creative arts classroom, or you can enjoy it outside. Draw, paint, sketch, build, create, write or carve: whatever you feel and whatever you want.

image.alt: A jar of paintbrushes on a straw bale
